title: EventBus callback mutation repeated-cycle stability contract

contract.repeated_mutation: Callback registration and unregistration can be repeated across sequential delivery cycles
contract.delivery_stability: Each emit delivers only to callbacks active in that cycle
contract.registry_cleanup: Unregistered callbacks are removed from the listener registry
contract.registry_reactivation: Newly registered callbacks become active for subsequent emits
contract.duplicate_prevention: Repeated mutation cycles do not create duplicate callback entries
contract.ordering: Existing callback order remains stable across mutation cycles
contract.registry_stability: The listener registry remains structurally consistent after repeated mutations
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful across repeated mutation cycles
contract.permission_enforcement: EventBus callback mutation operations require the events permission
